notes.title: Release Day Update!
notes.content: I’m writing this post just minutes before The Short Story goes live. I’m super excited about the release but I’m even more excited about ongoing support and development! I want the keep making The Short Story better for everyone who plays it, so please feel free to post feature requests, suggestions, and any other ideas you may have in the Steam community group. I’ll make sure to read each and every one of them. The 1.1 update will be a direct response to any suggestions that you all have. Thanks for playing!
